optimal_snr — ONED matched op

• 数据种类:signal × pairs → measurement

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.optimal_snr(template, psd, rate: 'float' = 4096.0, *, f_low_hz: 'float | None' = 20.0, f_high_hz: 'float | None' = None) -> 'float'(要直接调用实现,import gwsearch; gwsearch.optimal_snr(template, psd, rate: 'float' = 4096.0, *, f_low_hz: 'float | None' = 20.0, f_high_hz: 'float | None' = None) -> 'float';从台账取用则 ops1d.get("optimal_snr"))

用法

模板的最优信噪比 σ = √(4∫|h̃|²/S df)（measurement）。
